title: Daily Intel Brief, Mon 23 Nov 2026 SGT
body:
Daily Intel Brief, Mon 23 Nov 2026 SGT

Read-through: The AI-capex unwind, a hiking Fed and Hormuz shipping risk are one liquidity squeeze. Japan is shut today, so Asia's first read on Friday's tech rout comes from Hong Kong, Korea and Taiwan, with core PCE on Wednesday the next hard data point.

## Top 5 headlines

**Wall Street ended its worst week since 2020: the Nasdaq fell 10%, Nvidia dropped 23% on the week, and Anthropic closed Friday at $88.91 against an $83 IPO price.** CNBC cites rising rates, anti-AI sentiment, Jensen Huang's sudden exit from Nvidia and slowing AI spend, and TradingView shows the VIX at 35.9 and the 10-year yield at 4.95%. Forced de-grossing in the AI complex is what is dragging crypto, so Monday's Nasdaq futures and Nvidia's open are the first test of whether Friday was capitulation. — [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/21/anthropic-ipo-tech-selloff.html), [Quartz](https://qz.com/anthropic-stock-slips-record-ipo-ai-selloff-nvidia-amd-112026)

**Bitcoin trades near $61,199 and Ether near $1,721 on Crypto.com perpetuals at 23:53 UTC, up from the prior brief's $60,125 and $1,682.** The prior 24-hour range on that venue was $58,644 to $61,577, and trackers put US spot bitcoin ETF outflows near $1.12 billion for 16 to 20 November, with about $1.53 billion of liquidations on 21 November, mostly longs. Different trackers give different liquidation totals, so treat them as approximate; a bounce into ETF outflows leaves $60,000 as the level that matters at Monday's US open. — [Crypto Times](https://www.cryptotimes.io/2026/11/21/crypto-market-falls-5-to-2-12t-as-traders-face-1-53b-in-liquidations/), [FinanceFeeds](https://financefeeds.com/us-crypto-etfs-record-714-6-million-in-outflows-as-blackrock-leads-bitcoin-and-ethereum-redemptions/)

**Update: Al Jazeera counts at least 25 tankers hit in and around Hormuz in the past week, with war-risk insurance at 3.5% to 7.5% of hull value versus 0.10% to 0.25% before the war.** Ship transits fell 15% week on week, oil briefly topped $100 before easing to about $83, and Iran is pairing radar strikes on US sites in Bahrain with talks via Qatari mediators. The risk premium sits in freight and insurance as much as in crude, so the next tanker strike or a Qatari-brokered pause is the swing factor into the Asia open. — [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/whats-behind-irans-escalation-of-attacks-in-the-gulf), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/tankers-hit-in-strait-of-hormuz-as-iran-tightens-grip-on-shipping)

**Update: Markets still price a December 8-9 Fed hike at roughly 88% to 99% depending on the source, with core PCE and Q3 GDP due Wednesday at 8:30 a.m. New York time.** Nearly all officials favour 25 basis points, with Governor Waller earlier arguing for 50 and Treasury Secretary Bessent against it. A hawkish PCE surprise would lift the 50 basis point odds and re-pressure the 10-year, which TradingView shows at 4.95% with the 2-year at 4.649%. — [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/markets-bracing-another-fed-rate-015247271.html), [FinanceFeeds](https://financefeeds.com/gold-price-today-3538-sunday-week-ahead-thanksgiving-december-fed-hike-odds-bull-3700-bear-3430/)

**Japanese markets are closed Monday for Labor Thanksgiving Day, after the Nikkei fell about 5% on Friday to roughly 56,400 to 56,500.** Sources differ slightly on the close. Thin yen trading with USD/JPY near 158.84 on TradingView and the 10-year JGB at 2.784% leaves carry positions unable to react in Tokyo, so a gap on Tuesday's reopen is the risk to watch. — [investingLive](https://investinglive.com/news/economic-and-event-calendar-in-asia-23-november-2026-japanese-markets-are-closed-today/), [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/japan/stock-market)

## Geopolitics and Security

**Russia launched 186 drones at Ukraine overnight into 22 November, and Ukrainian air defences downed 161, according to Ukrinform.** A strike on a supermarket in Vyshneve near Kyiv has killed at least two, and Zelensky put the week's total at about 2,700 drones, 1,460 guided bombs and 165 missiles. Dates on several of these pages are unclear, so treat counts as Ukrinform's own tally. Sustained strikes on Ukrainian energy and cities keep European gas and defence risk premia live. — [Ukrinform](https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato)

**Iran says the IRGC hit radars at US bases in Bahrain and shot down a US MQ-1 drone, while CENTCOM denied the claimed F-16 hit.** Bahrain says an Iranian strike on Saturday started a fire at a civilian industrial site in Sitra, and Bessent projects a 25% contraction of Iran's economy by March 2027. Iran calls the blockade an act of war, so a Qatari-mediated pause or a new US strike on Iran is the binary for oil. — [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/whats-behind-irans-escalation-of-attacks-in-the-gulf)

## Asia

**The Hang Seng closed Friday at 22,410.81, down 1.89%, and Singapore's STI fell 2.05% to 4,975.18, per TradingView.** Both followed Wall Street's chip-led rout rather than a local catalyst. With Tokyo shut, Hong Kong and Singapore carry Monday's Asian risk read, and a hold above Friday's lows would be the first sign of stabilisation.

**Update: Taiwan's short-sale ban below the prior close and the higher 150% short margin take effect today after the TAIEX's 6.23% drop on Friday.** Rules aimed at forced selling mean Monday's TAIEX open is a read on chip supply-chain sentiment, and the stabilisation fund's buying is the flow to track. — [Focus Taiwan](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202611210013)

## Rates and Bonds

**Three Treasury auctions in three days start with the 2-year note on Monday.** Yields fell Friday as equities rolled over, with the 10-year at 4.95% on TradingView, so auction tails would show whether haven demand or supply fatigue dominates. A weak 2-year at a 4.65% handle into a December hike would tighten financial conditions further. — [Option Beast](https://wp.optionbeast.com/2026/11/22/three-treasury-auctions-in-three-days-watch-these-yield-levels/)

## Markets and Crypto

**Gold gained 1.29% to about $3,584 on TradingView while the dollar index barely moved at 103.82.** Gold is still far below its early-September peak and Goldman Sachs is cited by Yahoo as warning that the stock selloff is not over, so metals and crypto are trading as liquidity, not hedges, which CNBC also argued on 20 November. A close back above $3,600 would suggest forced gold selling has eased. — [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/commodities/articles/great-cash-grab-crashing-gold-094952865.html)

Next 48h: Mon 23 Nov: Singapore October CPI 05:00 UTC, Japan closed, Taiwan short-sale ban in force, euro-area and US flash PMIs, 2-year Treasury auction; Tue 24 Nov: Conference Board consumer confidence, 5-year auction; Wed 25 Nov: core PCE and Q3 GDP; Thu 26 Nov: US markets closed for Thanksgiving, thinning liquidity.

Content angle: A hiking Fed, an AI IPO that opened at $111.50 and closed the week at $88.91, and a closed Tokyo market are the same story: when funding costs rise, the crowded trade goes first and the narrative catches up later. Bounces inside a liquidity squeeze are inventory management, not conviction.
"Anthropic IPO'd at $83, hit $111, closed the week at $88. Nvidia fell 23%. Tokyo is shut today. In a liquidity squeeze the question isn't whether the story is true, it's who has to sell before you do."
